items.title: Great white shark
items.description: The great white shark, also known as the white shark, white pointer or great white, is a large shark. It is closely related to the mako sharks, the porbeagle and the salmon shark. items.title: Jensen Huang
items.description: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and business executive who is the co-founder, president, and chief executive officer (CEO) of Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable companies. As of November 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth at US$143.4 billion, making him the 13th-wealthiest person in the world.

items.title: Moon
items.description: The Moon is the only natural satellite of Earth. It orbits Earth in an elliptical path, at a distance that varies over the year, averaging around 378,000 kilometers (235,000 mi). items.title: Linux
items.description: Linux is a family of free and open-source software Unix-like operating systems based on the Linux kernel, which was first released on 17 September 1991 by Linus Torvalds.
